facts.text: Jake and Bobbie Joe on the trail
facts.why: Same spelling slip in the footer line. The sources spell the name Bobby Joe.

facts.text: Jake's jug, carried all the way up the trail.
facts.why: Wikipedia has handyman Jake and Bobby Joe leading the group to the cabin on foot. No source or transcript line mentions a jug or cider on the trek.
facts.fix: Jake's the guide, so Jake gets the cider.

vibe.verdict: Good cabin world with the laughing room, the cellar and the chainsaw, but the food reads like a stock camp menu.
missing: Ash pinning his hand under a book (A Farewell to Arms)
Groovy, said once the chainsaw is on the stump
Linda's head biting Ash's hand (the cabin floor)
The Oldsmobile Delta 88 sucked into the time vortex
Knights hailing Ash as the hero from the sky
The shotgun, sawn off with Annie's help
ideas: Swap the note on 'Ash's runaway hand pies' for 'Pin them down with a book. A Farewell to Arms will do.'
Swap the note on 'Laughing room peach iced tea' for 'Who's laughing now?' (Ash, hand pinned with a kitchen knife).
Rename 'Knowby cabin pecan pie' to 'Groovy pecan pie' with the note 'Baked once the chainsaw is on the stump.'
Swap the footer line about the mounted deer head for 'The Oldsmobile Delta 88, last seen in the Middle Ages.'
